name: Isawa Tae
source:
Favorite food: Mitarashidango (a kind of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dango]dango[/url])
Favorite drink: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hojicha]Hojicha[/url]

Tae is the Student Council President and [url=/c12955]Kenji[/url]'s senpai in school. She has a short dark purple hair and often seen wearing her jersey uniform. She is a very mature, good-tempered and responsible person. She has three younger siblings (two brothers and one sister) to take care of.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
